raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Preemption count alone does not show how much model work was discarded. This
change adds an exact cumulative Prometheus counter for token positions that are
executed again after scheduler preemption:

`vllm:recomputed_token_executions_total`

The scheduler records the highest completed position made stale by preemption
and counts only subsequently scheduled positions below that frontier. Prefix
cache hits are not scheduled, so they are not counted as recomputed execution.

## Scope

- Carry the per-step recomputed-token count through `SchedulerOutput` and
  `SchedulerStats`.
- Expose it through the existing Prometheus logger.
- Cover exact scheduler accounting and cumulative metric export.

This is not a duplicate: I searched open vLLM PRs for recomputed-token,
preemption-compute, and related scheduler-metric work. No other open PR adds
this exact counter; the only direct result was this PR's earlier revision.

## Test plan and results

- `uvx pre-commit run --files <all seven changed files>`: passed, including
  Ruff, typos, mypy, SPDX, forbidden-import, and configuration checks.
- `python -m pytest -q tests/v1/metrics/test_histogram_buckets.py`: 13 passed.
- Focused scheduler and metric selection: 3 passed, 173 deselected.
- Full `tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py` plus the metric test: 175 passed; one
  unrelated local-environment failure because the existing pipeline-parallel
  test requires two visible GPUs and the test host has one.

No model evaluation is required: this is observability-only and does not alter
model outputs, accuracy, scheduling decisions, or serving responses.

## AI assistance

OpenAI Codex assisted with rebasing the original change onto current `main`,
adapting it to the current scheduler API, tests, and this description. The
commit includes an AI-attribution trailer. The PR remains a draft until the
human submitter reviews every changed line and can explain the implementation
end to end.

@@ -1546,6 +1546,49 @@ def test_preemption_processes_stale_aux_output():
     scheduler.aux_output_connector.take_output.assert_called_once_with(request, None)
 
 
+def test_preemption_counts_exact_recomputed_token_executions():
+    scheduler = create_scheduler(enable_prefix_caching=False)
+    request = create_requests(num_requests=1, num_tokens=8)[0]
+    scheduler.add_request(request)
+
+    first = scheduler.schedule()
+    assert first.num_recomputed_tokens == 0
+    scheduler.update_from_output(
+        first,
+        ModelRunnerOutput(
+            req_ids=[request.request_id],
+            req_id_to_index={request.request_id: 0},
+            sampled_token_ids=[[1000]],
+            logprobs=None,
+            prompt_logprobs_dict={},
+            pooler_output=[],
+        ),
+    )
+
+    # Eight positions completed before preemption. The resumed step schedules
+    # those eight again plus one new position, so only eight are recomputation.
+    scheduler.running.remove(request)
+    scheduler._preempt_request(request, 0.0)
+    resumed = scheduler.schedule()
+    assert resumed.num_scheduled_tokens[request.request_id] == 9
+    assert resumed.num_recomputed_tokens == 8
+
+    outputs = scheduler.update_from_output(
+        resumed,
+        ModelRunnerOutput(
+            req_ids=[request.request_id],
+            req_id_to_index={request.request_id: 0},
+            sampled_token_ids=[[1001]],
+            logprobs=None,
+            prompt_logprobs_dict={},
+            pooler_output=[],
+        ),
+    )
+    stats = outputs[request.client_index].scheduler_stats
+    assert stats is not None
+    assert stats.num_recomputed_tokens == 8
+
+
